name: Chaos Temple ents (Wilderness)
accessNote: 10 Wilderness ent spawns near the Chaos Temple: 4 to the east and 6 to the north. Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills, so the level 86 Woodcutting Guild ent does not count. Bring a hatchet to chop the defeated trunks for noted logs. Ents are not cannon-immune and the open Wilderness area is not cannon-prohibited (Ent pageid 31267); they can be safespotted 1-3 tiles from a tree.
